status: frozen after v1 pre-feature feasibility failure and before representativeness outcomes

supersedes.reason: A fixed 180-to-15-day pre-anchor concentration window has fewer than 30 observations for at least one otherwise eligible anchor. No v1 result files were produced.

population: All 563 eligible 2019-2025 AQS 88101 Method Code anchors

concentration_feature.name: target_previous_method_run_median_ug_m3
concentration_feature.definition: Median target concentration across the complete prior Method Code run recorded in the anchor inventory.
concentration_feature.rationale: The frozen anchor eligibility rule guarantees this count, preserving the entire population without outcome-based exclusion.

unavailable_feature.name: urban_rural_status
unavailable_feature.reason: No verified urban/rural classification is included in the frozen AQS daily-data slice.

descriptive_logistic_model.subpopulation: Anchors with at least one qualified geographic donor
descriptive_logistic_model.excluded_predictor_reason: It directly participates in the auditability eligibility rule and would create a tautological model.
descriptive_logistic_model.interpretation: Descriptive association only; coefficients do not assign effects or predict physical measurement bias.

reporting.standardized_difference: Complete minus unavailable anchors using pooled sample standard deviation.
reporting.geographic_reporting: EPA regions using fixed state-code mapping; AQS state code 80 is retained and separately reported as Outside EPA mapped regions.

interpretation_boundary: An unavailable comparison cannot be imputed as biased or unbiased. This analysis describes benchmark applicability only.
